title: Setback to an adjoining laneway or right-of-way that is the primary street
text: C3.3.1 Buildings are set back from the street boundary in accordance with Table 3.3a. Table 3.3a Minimum setback of buildings from the street, adjoining laneway or right-of-way where it is the primary street to the dwelling (1): R2, R2.5, R5, R10 and R12.5 as per Secondary Street setbacks; R15-25, R30-35, R40 and R50-80 1.5m. (1) Does not apply to ancillary dwellings.

replaces.note: 2.5 m (1.5 m porch) where ROW is the main frontage -> 1.5 m
ROW as primary street 2 m -> 1.5 m

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Table 3.3a footnote 1: this row does not apply to ancillary dwellings (applies_to is single_house only).

verified.note: Merged cells confirmed on the page: 'As per Secondary Street setbacks' spans R2 to R12.5 for both laneway rows; 1.5m spans R15-25 to R50-80.
